thesis: nVent Electric (NYSE: NVT): electrical connection, protection and enclosure products, with data center and utility exposure. Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-10-30) read. Q3 sales 1,514.9M (+43.7%), 9M 4,228.2M (+49.6%), largely the Avail Electrical Products Group acquired 2025-05-01 for 979.6M; 9M NI from continuing operations 558.6M vs 312.7M (9M25 total NI 591.4M included discontinued gains). 9M OCF continuing 581.9M, capex 94.6M. On 2026-10-01 closed Maverick Power for about 1.75B cash (plus up to 550M contingent), financed with 800M notes due 2036 and a 600M term loan; pro forma net debt about 2.8B (own estimate). Close 101.84 (2026-11-20, -5.8% that day, cause not found) x 161.60M shares = 16.46B = 24.4x TTM continuing NI 674.4M, TTM FCF 673.0M (4.1%) before Maverick.
counterthesis: Reported growth is acquisition-driven and the TTM multiple mixes pre- and post-deal bases; leverage rises from about 0.2x net to roughly 2.8B net debt after Maverick; 550M contingent consideration; data center capex cycle dependence not examined; tariff credits of 22.2M year to date appear in the segment reconciliation; the 5.8% one-day fall is unexplained.
invalidation: Downgrade if organic growth fades, Maverick integration disappoints or leverage covenants tighten; revisit when two quarters including Maverick are reported.
